It takes twenty minutes to get to the city library by bike. Eva learned a lot about music. The city library is one of the best places in the city. What's more, the manual was unhelpful and badly translated.
Life is full of small surprises. Eva's favorite animal is the cat. Eva is reading a book about music. What's more, the trial has a money-back guarantee.
